events.description: Saves the pending changes; a returned promise keeps Save busy, and the changes clear once it resolves.
events.name: onSave

events.description: Called with the pending changes each time they change, for example to warn before leaving.
events.name: onChangesChange

props.description: The grid's spoken name, for example "Price list".
props.name: label

props.description: The columns in reading order; the first names each row.
props.name: columns

props.description: True to show the values without letting them be edited.
props.name: isReadOnly

props.description: `sheet`, the default, or `matrix`: number cells with a total per row and per column.
props.name: variant

props.description: Web: how many leading columns stay in view while the grid scrolls sideways. Defaults to 1.
props.name: frozenColumns

props.description: Web: the height of a row in CSS pixels; rows are virtualised at this height. Defaults to 36.
props.name: rowHeight

props.description: Web: the height the rows scroll inside, as a CSS length. Defaults to `24rem`.
props.name: height

props.description:
The collection engine to arrange the columns from (`useCollection`), as DataView passes it: their order, names,
widths, pins and visibility. Left out, the grid runs its own engine over `columns`, the first `frozenColumns`
pinned to the start.
props.name: collection

props.description: The key the grid's own engine keeps the user's column layout under; left out, nothing persists.
props.name: collectionKey

props.description: Web: how tall the rows are when `rowHeight` is not given: `compact` 30, `normal` 36, `roomy` 48.
props.name: density

props.description:
Web: true to give each header a resize handle (drag it, or focus it and use the arrows, Home and End), drag to
reorder, and the column menu. Defaults to false.
props.name: hasColumnTools

events.description: Commits the draft (or `draft`, when a select hands its choice straight over) and moves on.
events.name: onCommit

props.description: The column, which picks the input.
props.name: column

props.description: The input's accessible name: the column and the row.
props.name: label
